title: CodeAgentEvidence
description: Structured, traceable code/diff evidence produced by the Code Agent. This is not a root-cause diagnosis.

incident_id.description: Identifier of the analyzed incident bundle.

summary.description: Short organisation of code/diff observations. Must not claim a verified root cause.

evidence.description: Prioritised code evidence items with stable IDs and precise source/diff references.

reference.description: Precise locator such as service/app.py:40-42 or git_diff.patch:hunk 1.

excerpt.description: Exact original source or diff text. Must not be paraphrased.

interpretation.description: LLM organisation/priority note. Observational only, not a diagnosis.
